Plugin Studio — start here

What you can build on top of SATOM without changing its code, who can build it, and the path through this section from your first view to publishing in production.

👤 ForAdministratorAdvanced user
🔑 Permissionsstudio.plugin_studio studio.script_library studio.python_console
📍 WherePlugins → Report Studio (views) · Plugin Studio, first level of the sidebar (apps, scripts, data stores, connections, API Catalog) · Administrator → System → Database → Plugin datasets
On this page
  • What you can build
  • Who can build what
  • The path through this section
  • Where things are

What you can build#

SATOM lets an administrator add their own pages and tools on top of it, without changing SATOM's code and without giving anyone SQL or a device password. Four things can be built, all of them called plugins:

Report Studio

📊View

A page — a table, KPI cards, a chart — over SATOM's data. Jinja/HTML plus optional CSS and JavaScript. Published views appear under Custom Views for everyone in that ADOM. Start with Your first view.

Report Studio

🧱Widget

The same as a view, sized to sit next to others. Built and published the same way.

Plugin Studio

🔀Flow app

A form people fill in, a diagram of steps that does the work (read and write data stores, call an API, run a script, reserve addresses, create a FortiWeb server policy…) and an output with actions. See Your first app.

Plugin Studio

🐍Script app

Python code with a form, run in a sandbox with no database and, by default, no network. See Your first script.

Every one of them reads data the same way: through datasets (views), data stores (apps and scripts) and connections (apps and scripts). Nothing a plugin does reaches SATOM's database or a device directly: SATOM hands it what it may see, and does the writing itself, after the checks.

Who can build what#

You want to You need
Open a published view (Custom Views) or run a published app Signed in (an app also names the groups or people it is for)
Build, preview and publish views and widgets (Report Studio) studio.plugin_studio
Build apps and scripts, data stores, connections, the API Catalog (Plugin Studio) studio.script_library
Try Python over the fleet's datasets (the Console pane) studio.python_console
Build plugin datasets for everyone (Administrator → Database) users.manage and studio.plugin_studio
Import packages, register trusted publishers studio.plugin_studio

Only the seeded admin profile holds these keys out of the box. See Users and profiles to give them to others.

The path through this section#

  1. 1Conceptsthe ten words everything else uses — 10 minutes
  2. 2Your first viewa fleet table with a device filter, published
  3. 3Datasetsthe ~600 sources of data a view can read, and how to add your own
  4. 4Writing viewsJinja, inputs, CSS, JavaScript, patterns
  5. 5Your first appa form, a diagram, a data store, an output
  6. 6Your first scriptPython with a form, in the sandbox
  7. 7Test and publishdraft → testing → published, packages, other servers
  8. 8SATOM Builderbuild and test away from production, with an assistant
  9. 9Recipesready-to-copy views and apps
  10. 10Troubleshootingevery message, what it means, what to do
  1. Concepts — read this first.
  2. Your first view — a complete tutorial.
  3. Datasets: the data a view reads and Build a plugin dataset (administrators).
  4. Writing views — the reference you keep open while writing.
  5. Your first app and Your first script.
  6. Test and publish.
  7. Build with SATOM Builder.
  8. Recipes and Troubleshooting.

The detailed reference of each screen stays where it was: Report Studio and Custom Views, Plugin Studio apps, Script Library, Data stores, Connections, API Catalog, Examples, What Studio code cannot do, SATOM Builder.

Where things are#

Screen Where
Report Studio (views, widgets) Plugins → Report Studio in a device ADOM; Global → Plugins → Report Studio in the Global ADOM
Custom Views (published views) Plugins → Custom Views in a device ADOM
Plugin Studio (apps, scripts, data stores, connections, API Catalog, Console, Examples) Plugin Studio, first level of the sidebar
Published apps (for the people who run them) Plugins (each published app is an entry)
Plugin datasets Administrator → System → Database → Plugin datasets
SATOM Builder A separate tool installed on its own server — see SATOM Builder

💡Tip

Never built anything before? Open Plugin Studio → Examples and install one of the ready-made apps, or click Browse examples in Report Studio. Read what it does, change one thing, preview it. Then come back to Your first view.
